slides.title: Problem: College Food is Expensive & Unhealthy
bullets: Hostel students spend $150+/month on delivery apps with high fees
Over 70% rely on low-quality fast food due to lack of healthy options near dorms
Irregular eating habits harm student health and academic focus
slides.visual_concept: Split screen: Expensive food bill vs Unhealthy fast food box
slides.speaker_notes: Every student living in a hostel knows the struggle: food delivery apps are too expensive, and local options are repetitive and oily.

slides.title: Solution: NutriNest Healthy Campus Dining
bullets: Curated marketplace of vetted local healthy mess providers
Flexible monthly & weekly meal plans starting at $2.50/meal
Batch dorm delivery cutting delivery fees to zero

scripts.elevator_pitch_30s: Hi, I'm building NutriNest. Hostel college students spend hundreds of dollars on delivery apps for unhealthy fast food. NutriNest connects students with curated local mess vendors, offering fresh, home-cooked meals for under $3 a day delivered right to their dorms. We're unlocking a $4.8B student food market.
scripts.overview_pitch_2min: Good day investors. Over 10 million college students live away from home in university hostels. Today, they face a double penalty: campus canteens lack quality and variety, while mainstream apps like Swiggy charge heavy delivery fees. NutriNest solves this with a dedicated student food subscription network. By batching orders at dorm drop-off hubs, we reduce delivery costs by 80% and pass those savings to students. We take a 12% commission from vendors and offer a $15/month delivery pass. We are seeking seed funding to launch our pilot across 5 major university campuses.
scripts.full_pitch_5min: Welcome investors. Today we present NutriNest—the healthy food app for college students. On Slide 1, you see our core problem: high costs and poor nutrition for hostel residents. Slide 2 outlines our solution: a curated marketplace for affordable meal plans with zero-fee dorm batching. On Slide 3, our market analysis shows a $4.8B TAM. Slide 4 details our dual revenue stream: vendor commissions and student passes. Finally, Slide 5 highlights our rollout strategy. Thank you, and we welcome your questions.
